name: aitp-research-protocol
description: Local-first, evidence-grounded research protocol for theoretical physics
skillInstructions: This plugin is platform-neutral: the bundled CLI is scripts/aitp.py and needs Python 3.11 or newer. On Kimi Code, invoke the entrypoint with /skill:aitp; any '$aitp' mention in the skills refers to that invocation. There is no MCP server, hook, or daemon by design.

interface.shortDescription: Grounded research continuity for theoretical physics.
interface.longDescription: Initialize a research workspace, recover source-linked project state, record durable results and failures with pinned evidence, write grounded notes, maintain current state automatically at session boundaries (enter/check, evidence review, closeout/working-note upkeep, zero writes when nothing durable changed), and distill stable repeated methods into local method cards with a human-gated publication path, and since 0.7.0 use evidence-lifecycle pins and reviewed workstream backfill.
